name: Adriano Santos
action: He answers the phone and tells Marina he can't make it to Sunday lunch because he's in the middle of a drum repair.
reason: Adriano's established pattern is to decline family invitations with a vague excuse, especially when he's absorbed in garage work. He is currently mid-repair on the snare, not wearing his hearing aids, and has skipped the last three Sundays without calling, reinforcing his tendency to avoid the loud gatherings he struggles with.
